name: blackout
description: Black-ground brutalist design: Outfit 900 uppercase headings with tight tracking, skewed parallelogram buttons, blue/black checkerboard tiles, diagonal-clipped blue bands. Built from the beanburito.github.io free-intro reference in Template Studio session #2.

hero.description: Dark photo hero, 76px uppercase 900 headline at 0.98 line-height, 20px sub, skewed black CTA with arrow.
hero.usage: First section of home and landing pages. Headline reads best at 3-6 words; it will be uppercased.

program-cards.description: Black section: compact left-aligned heading block, then 3-up tall (3:4) photo cards with uppercase names and arrow links.
program-cards.usage: Home and programs-index. Photos should be moody/high-contrast; they sit on pure black.

coach-grid.description: 3-up portraits with slight grayscale treatment, uppercase names, blue role labels, outlined cert chips.
coach-grid.usage: Coaches page; portraits get a unifying grayscale filter automatically.

schedule.description: Hairline-grid day columns on black, blue uppercase day labels.
schedule.usage: Schedule page. Dense but scannable; feed real times.

testimonials.description: Dark cards with blue top rule, blue stars, quoted 300-weight text, uppercase names.
testimonials.usage: Home proof slot and testimonials page.

faq.description: Hairline-divided accordion with uppercase questions and a rotating + marker; emits FAQPage JSON-LD.

cta-band.description: Blue band with diagonal clipped top/bottom, outline arrow graphics, uppercase heading, skewed black button — the template's signature conversion moment.
cta-band.usage: Close nearly every page with this. Heading will be uppercased; keep it a question or imperative.

location-map.description: Black split section: address/hours/phone left with blue skew button, map iframe or dark address panel right.

contact-form.description: Dark form: near-black inputs with hairline borders, uppercase micro-labels, blue skew submit.

lead-form.description: Blue diagonal-clipped section: uppercase heading + outline arrow left, white form card right, black skew submit.
lead-form.usage: getting-started and landing pages — primary conversion component.

pricing.description: Dark plan panels separated by hairlines, italic 900 prices, blue arrow feature markers; featured plan gets blue top rule and tinted panel.

feature-grid.description: Two families: light bands and the checkerboard.

variants.default: white band, blue line icons, 30px uppercase titles
variants.numbered: white band with 64px italic blue numerals — for sequences
variants.cards: white band trio (same as default, icon-led) placed right after hero
variants.dark: the blue/black checkerboard tiles with line icons and italic uppercase titles — the reference's signature amenities look

feature-grid.usage: Use light variants to break up black sections; use dark checkerboard exactly once per page as the feature moment.

content-block.description: Measured prose on black: uppercase heading, 300-weight 17px paragraphs.
content-block.usage: About/pillar narrative. Stack multiple blocks for long stories.

media-block.description: Heading + copy beside an unframed high-contrast photo; blue skew CTA optional.
media-block.usage: Community/story sections on home and about.

stats-band.description: Blue diagonal-clipped band, 60px italic 900 values, uppercase micro-labels.

logo-strip.description: Muted uppercase label over inverted-grayscale logos on black.

home.notes: Same narrative arc as the vocabulary intends; alternate black and light/blue sections for rhythm — never two light bands adjacent.
